cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.intro: This page explains which browser storage technologies NewWebinars uses and how you can manage your choices.

what.title: What are cookies?
what.description: Cookies and local browser storage are small data records that help the website remember your session and preferences.

necessary.title: Necessary cookies
necessary.description: Used for authentication, security, language, theme, and consent preferences. They do not require consent because the service cannot function properly without them.

analytics.title: Analytics cookies
analytics.description: With your consent, they may be used for aggregated traffic and usage analysis. This category is disabled by default.

marketing.title: Marketing and affiliate tracking
marketing.description: With your consent, a random affiliate visitor identifier is stored so a referral can be attributed. This category is disabled by default.

choices.title: Your choices
choices.description: You can accept all, reject optional cookies, or choose individual categories. You can change your choice at any time through the link in the footer.
